CALIFA is the most complete, large, homogeneous and well-sampled integral-field survey to date.

CALIFA provides the most homogeneous dataset of stellar kinematics across the entire Hubble sequence, which can be used to explore the kinematic properties of galaxies and their scaling relations with a wide variety of galaxy properties.
